name: Related Posts Display
author: Bhavesh Nayi

sections.description:
Related Posts Display automatically shows related posts under each blog post, encouraging visitors to explore more content on your site. It fetches up to 3 related posts based on similar tags or categories, helping boost user engagement with minimal setup.

Key Features:
* Automatically displays related posts based on tags and categories.
* Fetches up to 3 related posts per blog post.
* Lightweight, with a simple installation and no extra configuration needed.
* Compatible with any theme and modern WordPress versions.
* Easily customizable via CSS for seamless theme integration.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/related-posts-display directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit any blog post to see related posts listed under the content.
sections.faq:
How are related posts determined?

Related posts are determined by analyzing tags and categories assigned to each post.

Can I customize the number of related posts displayed?

The plugin is set to display 3 related posts. You can modify the code to adjust this number if needed.

Does the plugin work with custom post types?

This version supports only standard posts. Additional development is required to support custom post types.

Will there be a settings panel for customization?

Future updates may include a settings panel for enhanced customization options.
